commands.thread_count: pids=$(ps -eo pid=,ppid=,comm=,args= | awk -v pat=sshd -v self=$$ -v parent=$PPID '$1 != self && $1 != parent && $2 != self && $2 != parent && ($3 ~ pat || $0 ~ pat) && $3 !~ /^(awk|grep|pgrep|ps|ss|bash|sh|timeout)$/ {print $1}' | paste -sd, -); if [ -z "$pids" ]; then echo 0; else ps -o nlwp= -p "$pids" 2>/dev/null | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}'; fi
